caption: The video captures a paved cycle path between a stone wall and fence and houses on the left and a grassy bank of pink trees on the right. A cyclist in a bright pink top rides ahead on a bicycle with a rear basket holding a light-colored bag. The viewpoint moves forward along the path behind the rider, keeping her near the center. As the camera advances, the white house at the upper left slides out of view and the pink house becomes more prominent. The row of blossoming trees shifts in perspective and passes toward the right edge. The cyclist continues forward in a riding posture, without stopping or turning. The distance between the viewpoint and the rider gradually decreases while the path and scenery keep sliding past.
